realReviews.author: Stanley Joyce
realReviews.text:
Our Family,
Has hired Handyman Rob on 4 seperate occasions for different jobs. Rob did an exterior siding and window reseal, followed with creating the mantle of our dreams from a piece of wood we purchased, he designed and built 475 square feet of 8 ft tall completey wooden fence, lastly we recently hired him to complete a board and madden wall for us. We are extremely excited to see the finished product. Handyman Rob is a professional from start of a project all the way through. The difference between Handyman Rob and others is the constant communication he has with you all the way through the job. I personally recommend Handyman Rob for any job!!!!!

realReviews.author: Lisa Jenkins
realReviews.text: Quick response, arrived within 1 hour to evaluate; provided quote, arrived when he said he would arrive to do the job; wasted no time, cleaned up behind himself; price charged was price quoted. Rob is personable, honest, fair, and exceeded my expectations. Will keep him on speed dial! Installed 3 different closet organizers.

realReviews.author: Sharon Ong
realReviews.text: Handyman Rob did exactly what I needed and more! I needed a shed installed in my yard and not only did he assemble the shed, he constructed a level pad and took into account drainage and floor clearance. The finished product is more professional than I imagined. I also appreciated his communication and the fact that he responded and kept his word to doing the job. I highly recommend Handyman Rob to anyone!

finalCta.headline: Got a job or a list of them?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time to talk it through. You'll get a straight quote before any work starts.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a fair price.

faq.a: Yes. Odd jobs and small repairs are welcome, and a list of them is even better.

faq.q: Can you build fences and mantels?
faq.a: Yes. Wood fences, mantels, board and batten walls and other carpentry projects.

faq.q: Do you repair siding and windows?
faq.a: Yes. Siding rehangs, window repairs and reseals, and rotted wood replacement.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Rob, you get a text and email confirmation, and he follows up to talk through the job.
